environment.sandbox: enabled (no --no-sandbox; non-root user; Chromium refuses to start without a usable sandbox)

checks.name: A can read its own cookie/localStorage/IndexedDB
B cannot read A values (cookie, localStorage, IndexedDB)
B never sends A cookie to the origin
A still sees only its own values after B writes
values persist per directory across restarts

observations.name: second process on a directory already in use
observations.result: a second process started on the same directory
observations.consequence: The browser does not protect the directory. The manager must hold an exclusive per-profile lock before launch (milestone 03).

scope_note: Proves separation of stored browser data (cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB) between user-data directories. It does not test, and the product must not claim, that profiles appear as different devices or networks.
